changelog:
Xiaohongshu-search skill v1.0.0 – Initial release.

- Enables keyword-based search of Xiaohongshu (RedNote/xhs) notes, returning paginated lists with titles, authors, engagement stats (likes, collects, comments), cover image URLs, and tokens for detail lookup.
- Supports manual application of sort and note-type filters using the on-page filter panel.
- Requires user to be logged in to Xiaohongshu in the browser; login status is automatically checked before execution.
- Extracts visible search result data without bypassing authentication, adhering to the user's current session and access permissions.
- Pagination is handled by simulated scrolling and repeated extraction until all results are loaded.
- Includes error handling for login state, page readiness, and extraction issues.
summary: Search Xiaohongshu (RedNote / xhs) notes by keyword and return a paginated list with title, author, engagement stats (likes, collects, comments), cover image URL, and xsecToken for detail lookup.
